scope: Training-only B2 sample-policy controls and D1/D2/D3 feature ablations
unit: Question; all four candidates kept together
feature_cache: Only deterministic train inputs; no reference fields passed to extractors
base75: Exact original text_features.extract_features shared by all arms, including its existing float32 centering; no precision wrapper or base feature edit

feature_definition.D1: Directed cross-answer derived-number containment and early-stop proxies; question numbers and explicit final-answer markers excluded
feature_definition.D2: Shared non-final derived numbers supported by distinct parsed-answer groups, coverage, order and leave-own-group consensus
feature_definition.D3: Six question-target keyword categories crossed with the outermost operation of the last parseable equality
feature_definition.numeric_equivalence: Fractions represented exactly where possible; relative/absolute tolerance1e-6 for numeric mention matching only; official exact parser still controls answer grouping/labels
feature_definition.caveat: Numeric occurrence and lexical target cues do not prove semantic implication or step validity

sample_policies.all_candidates: all four rows from each fitting question, including parser-invalid candidates; reproduces deployed tree sampling
sample_policies.all_valid: valid rows from all fitting questions, unit row weight
sample_policies.hard_valid: valid rows from questions with at least two distinct valid answers, unit row weight
sample_policies.hard_valid_question_weighted: same hard/valid rows, weight4/(valid candidates in question), each question weight4

aggregation: Official-parser same-answer group mean, zero consensus bonus
score_normalization: Raw scores centered across all four candidates; std at valid candidate entries from all outer-fitting questions; held-out questions never enter the scale
reporting: Each repeat separately, paired repair/regression and question-balanced group cross-entropy; repeated questions are not independent new observations
training_selection_order: highest summed hard-correct across both repeats
deployment: No promotion, validation, test or full-training refit in this driver; all fold trees exported for later inspection
adaptation: No extra configurations or feature tuning after scores; implementation repairs recorded separately
minimum_independent_evaluation: New folds reduce split dependence, but all hypotheses and old recipes were informed by earlier research; OOF selection remains exploratory
